(rule!
  (let ((seen (make-hash))
        (best-score #f)
        (best-cells (list))
        (best-color 0))
    (define (score-better? score old)
      (or (not old)
          (> (first score) (first old))
          (and (= (first score) (first old))
               (or (> (second score) (second old))
                   (and (= (second score) (second old))
                        (> (third score) (third old)))))))
    (for* ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
      (unless (or (hash-has-key? seen (cons r c)) (= (at g r c) 5))
        (define queue (list (cons r c)))
        (define cells (list))
        (hash-set! seen (first queue) #t)
        (let bfs ([fuel 0])
          (unless (empty? queue)
            (let ((cur (first queue)))
              (set! queue (rest queue))
              (set! cells (cons (list (car cur) (cdr cur)) cells))
              (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d))) (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
                  (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                             (not (= (at g nr nc) 5))
                             (not (hash-has-key? seen (cons nr nc))))
                    (hash-set! seen (cons nr nc) #t)
                    (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc))))))))
            (bfs (+ fuel 1))))
        (let* ((seed-values (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
                                    (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) cells))))
          (unless (empty? seed-values)
            (define counts (make-hash))
            (for ([v (in-list seed-values)])
              (hash-update! counts v add1 0))
            (define top-color
              (first (sort (hash-keys counts)
                           (lambda (a b)
                             (if (= (hash-ref counts a) (hash-ref counts b))
                                 (< a b)
                                 (> (hash-ref counts a) (hash-ref counts b)))))))
            (define score (list (length seed-values) (hash-ref counts top-color) (- 0 top-color)))
            (when (score-better? score best-score)
              (set! best-score score)
              (set! best-cells cells)
              (set! best-color top-color))))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (in-list best-cells)])
      (if (= (at out (first p) (second p)) 0)
          (set-cell out (first p) (second p) best-color)
          out))))
